_meta.description: Pre-authored finding templates with canonical IDs, bilingual titles, default severity, and fix labels.

recommendation.zh: 移除未被引用的导出符号
recommendation.en: Remove unreferenced export symbols

dead-code:unused-export.passCheck: No unreferenced exports remain in target files

recommendation.zh: 删除逻辑上永远不会执行的条件分支
recommendation.en: Remove logically unreachable conditional branches

dead-code:unreachable-branch.passCheck: All conditional branches are reachable under valid inputs

recommendation.zh: 移除声明后未被读取的变量
recommendation.en: Remove variables that are declared but never read

dead-code:unused-variable.passCheck: No unused variables remain in target scope

recommendation.zh: 提取公共逻辑为共享函数或模块
recommendation.en: Extract shared logic into a common function or module

duplication:clone-block.passCheck: Duplicated logic is consolidated into a single source of truth

recommendation.zh: 抽象重复的结构模式为通用模板或高阶函数
recommendation.en: Abstract repeated structural patterns into a generic template or HOF

duplication:repeated-pattern.passCheck: Pattern appears at most once, parameterized for variants

recommendation.zh: 使用原子操作、锁或序列化确保共享状态一致性
recommendation.en: Use atomic operations, locks, or serialization to ensure shared state consistency

concurrency:race-condition.passCheck: Concurrent access to shared state is serialized or atomic

recommendation.zh: 为异步调用添加 await 或正确处理 Promise 链
recommendation.en: Add await to async calls or properly handle the Promise chain

concurrency:missing-await.passCheck: All async return values are awaited or explicitly handled

title.zh: 未处理的 Promise 拒绝

recommendation.zh: 添加 .catch() 或 try/catch 处理可能的拒绝
recommendation.en: Add .catch() or try/catch to handle potential rejections

concurrency:unhandled-rejection.passCheck: All Promise chains have rejection handlers

recommendation.zh: 将职责分离为更小的单一职责函数
recommendation.en: Split responsibilities into smaller single-responsibility functions

design:god-function.passCheck: Function does one thing at one level of abstraction

recommendation.zh: 引入有意义的中间抽象以隐藏实现细节
recommendation.en: Introduce a meaningful intermediate abstraction to hide implementation details

design:missing-abstraction.passCheck: Consumers depend on abstraction, not implementation

recommendation.zh: 通过接口或依赖注入降低模块间耦合
recommendation.en: Reduce coupling via interfaces or dependency injection

design:tight-coupling.passCheck: Module depends on abstractions, not concrete implementations

recommendation.zh: 使用参数化查询、转义或白名单验证用户输入
recommendation.en: Use parameterized queries, escaping, or allowlist validation for user input

security:injection-risk.passCheck: All user-controlled data is sanitized before reaching sinks

recommendation.zh: 将密钥移至环境变量或密钥管理服务
recommendation.en: Move secrets to environment variables or a secrets manager

security:hardcoded-secret.passCheck: No secrets appear in source code

recommendation.zh: 将默认设置改为最小权限/最严格安全配置
recommendation.en: Change defaults to least-privilege / strictest secure configuration

security:insecure-default.passCheck: Default configuration follows principle of least privilege

recommendation.zh: 将字面量提取为命名常量
recommendation.en: Extract literals into named constants

maintainability:magic-number.passCheck: All domain-significant literals are named constants

recommendation.zh: 在抛出或传播错误时附加操作上下文信息
recommendation.en: Attach operation context when throwing or propagating errors

maintainability:missing-error-context.passCheck: Errors carry enough context to diagnose without reproducing

recommendation.zh: 统一命名风格以匹配项目约定
recommendation.en: Unify naming style to match project conventions

style:inconsistent-naming.passCheck: All symbols follow the project's naming convention

recommendation.zh: 迁移到推荐的替代 API
recommendation.en: Migrate to the recommended replacement API

legacy-safety:deprecated-api.passCheck: No deprecated API calls remain in target files

title.zh: AI 幻觉 API 调用

recommendation.zh: 验证 API 在目标库版本中确实存在，替换为正确方法
recommendation.en: Verify the API exists in the target library version; replace with the correct method

ai-sdd-smells:hallucinated-api.passCheck: All API calls resolve to real methods in declared dependencies

recommendation.zh: 简化为当前需求所需的最简实现
recommendation.en: Simplify to the minimal implementation required by current needs

recommendation.zh: 完成遗留的 TODO/FIXME 或存根实现
recommendation.en: Complete remaining TODO/FIXME or stub implementations

ai-sdd-smells:incomplete-implementation.passCheck: No TODO/FIXME/stub implementations remain in committed code
